svg.title: SimSiam architecture
svg.desc: Two views pass through a shared encoder and projection head to produce z1 and z2. A predictor h produces p1 and p2. Symmetrized cosine similarity loss with stop-gradient on z prevents collapse without negatives.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the SimSiam encoder differ from SimCLR?')
sendPrompt('What does the predictor MLP do in SimSiam?')
sendPrompt('Why does SimSiam use cosine similarity instead of InfoNCE?')
sendPrompt('What is the symmetrized loss formula in SimSiam?')
sendPrompt('Why does SimSiam not need negative pairs?')
g.text: No negatives · no momentum encoder · stop-grad prevents collapse
